Choose the attention temperature from transmitted moments

Source: R/attention.R
select_tau.Rd

A shortcut for [select_attention()] over temperatures alone.

Usage

select_tau(
  moments,
  k,
  taus = c(0, 2^seq(-10, 0), Inf),
  exclude = NULL,
  queries = NULL
)

Arguments

moments

A list of bp_moment objects.

k

Dimension of the keys.

taus

Candidate temperatures, Inf included by default.

exclude

Optional list giving, for each record, the indices of the records it must not attend to, such as other records of the same patient.

queries

Optional list of query matrices, one per record.

Value

The chosen temperature, with the mean error of each candidate in the attribute errors.

Examples

sim <- simulate_beats(H = 6, n = 60, p = 20, q = 3, seed = 5)
m <- lapply(sim$X, energy_moment, q = 5)
select_tau(m, k = 3)
